title: One feature as the survey reports it (status, feature list, feature show)

head.description: the feature branch's head; empty when the branch is gone

base.description: empty when the record couldn't be read

drift.description: whether the feature still merges cleanly onto public main; n/a when the branch is gone

gate.description: the last gate result; null when never gated

scanned_as.description: the mode the gate's leak scan covered; empty in a gate recorded by an older binary

fresh.description: the gate still matches the feature head, public main and the overlay

job.description: the gate job to wait on; null unless checks is pending

pr_state.description: the public PR's state; empty when never published, unknown when GitHub couldn't be asked

plan_id.description: the plan the feature was published from; empty when never published

moved.description: the branch moved since it was published; false when unpublished

parent.description: the feature this one is stacked on, or main; empty when the record couldn't be read

children.description: the live features stacked directly on this one

stack.description: the native GitHub stack its public PR is in

pr.description: how the open public PR compares with the feature; only for a published feature whose PR is open

behind.description: commits on the private branch the PR doesn't have

foreign.description: commits on the PR's branch Ghostbranch didn't publish (made on GitHub); feature pull brings them in

error.description: why the feature couldn't be surveyed; only with state unreadable (feature show returns it as its error)
